title: Atomek Production Missions
objective: Make Atomek Agent Team/Missions production-ready: visible mission files, task-first dispatch, durable runs, outputs, proposals, approvals, and resumable handoff.
nonNegotiables: Mission creation must collect a human mission name separate from goal and folder id.
Mission folder is the durable source of truth.
Mission files must be visible/editable in Atomek after creation.
Runs must save transcripts and durable records.
Patch/file writes require preview and approval.
Do not touch non-Atomek repos during this sprint.

greenLight.firstImplementationMove: Extract pure mission logic into src/workbench/missions/* with no visual behavior change.
greenLight.releaseRequires: All gates in ACCEPTANCE-GATES.md plus live localhost QA and release checks.
